measurement_note: The workload size n is the number of towers. Equal maximum limits force n consecutive downward choices; the closed-form total is an arithmetic series, while a used-set implementation that searches downward repeatedly performs quadratic work.

case = {'maximumHeight': [limit] * n}
expected = n * (2 * limit - n + 1) // 2
